title: #53 Digital Age
prompt: Some people claim that the digital age has made us lazier, while others claim it has made us more knowledgeable. Discuss both opinions, and use examples to support them.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The digital age makes people less active because they spend too much time looking at screens.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The digital age makes people less active because they spend too much time looking at screens.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology helps people learn, but this does not change the physical habits of people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The digital age can make people less active because they spend too much time on screens.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The digital age can make people less active because they spend too much time on screens.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The digital age provides easy access to information, which helps people learn many things.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The digital age provides easy access to information, which helps people learn many things.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The digital age causes laziness because people rely too much on technology for simple tasks, such as using GPS instead of learning map reading.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The digital age causes laziness because people rely too much on technology for simple tasks, such as using GPS instead of learning map reading.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, the digital age increases knowledge because information is widely available, allowing students to access global university lectures.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, the digital age increases knowledge because information is widely available, allowing students to access global university lectures.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The digital age provides easy and quick access to vast amounts of information, making learning more accessible for everyone, as demonstrated by students researching topics using computers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The digital age provides easy and quick access to vast amounts of information, making learning more accessible for everyone, as demonstrated by students researching topics using computers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Some argue that over-reliance on technology for simple tasks, such as using calculators, leads to a decrease in our own mental effort and capability.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Some argue that over-reliance on technology for simple tasks, such as using calculators, leads to a decrease in our own mental effort and capability.
